CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid Community Applications template for **hikvision-unifi-fire-bridge**: a Rust daemon that bridges a Hikvision thermal camera's fire and Temperature-Measurement-Alarm (TMA) events into a UniFi Protect Alarm Manager webhook — siren, priority push, or any other Alarm Manager action. Fail-loud by design; not certified life-safety equipment.
Source code, documentation, and support: https://github.com/Gasmanc/hikvision-unifi-fire-bridge
